label: Children/Pregnancy
assignment: Discover realistic pregnancy, infant, child, and parenting resources for families in {service_area}. Follow relationships from coordinating agencies and clinics to the specific prenatal care, material support, home visiting, childcare, developmental, and family programs people can actually use. Verify age or pregnancy stage, costs, coverage, schedules, service area, and enrollment.
include: Pregnancy testing, prenatal and postpartum care, childbirth education, and maternal health support
WIC-linked support, diapers, infant supplies, car seats, formula guidance, and material assistance
Home visiting, parenting education, early childhood, developmental screening, and early intervention
Childcare subsidies, respite care, school-readiness, and family support
Support for teen parents, high-risk pregnancy, pregnancy loss, disability, language, and transportation barriers
exclude: Ordinary child retailers or paid activities without a hardship-access program
Pregnancy-service marketing that obscures medical scope, credentials, cost, or service limitations
Programs outside the child's age or pregnancy stage unless a realistic referral pathway exists
